import pickle
import socket

def test():
    class MyClass:
        def __init__(self):
            self.name = "my_cls"

    s1 = [MyClass(), MyClass()]
    s2 = [MyClass(), MyClass()]
    Symbols = [MyClass(), MyClass()]

    with multiprocessing.Pool(processes=4) as pool:
        pool.map(lambda x: pool.apply_async(pickle.dumps, args=(x,)), s1)
        pool.map(lambda x: pool.apply_async(pickle.dumps, args=(x,)), s2)
        pool.map(lambda x: pool.apply_async(pickle.dumps, args=(x,)), Symbols)

    with socket:
        local, remote = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM), socket.socket(
            socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM
        )
        local.bind(("localhost", 8080))
        local.listen(1)
        lc, _ = local.accept()
        remote.connect(("remote.example.com", 80))
        remote.send(lc.recv(1024))
        lc.send(remote.recv(1024))
